title: Very Disappointing
text: I received both my Deadpool and Venom boxes with shipping labels on the collector's box.  If these were to be used as gifts, I wouldn't have given them because I don't want my shipping address stuck to someone's box that they may end up using for years for some type of stash box.  It's just ugly.  Didn't feel worth the price, especially when some items are dollar store quality.  The blue Venom t-shirt looks like someone made poor color judgement when they print them out.  I have a Stitch (Lilo & Stitch) Hangry t-shirt that looks very similar to this one.  I kept telling my husband it looked like Stitch without ears!  Overall, I am cancelling and will just go and buy the t-shirts and/or Pops I like and check the dollar store for the filler crap.
label: negative
